# Multi-Head Attention

> More heads.

**Type:** Learn + Build
**Languages:** Python
**Prerequisites:** Phase 7 · 02 (Self-Attention from Scratch)
**Time:** ~75 minutes

## Key Terms

| Term | What people say | What it actually means |
|------|-----------------|------------------------|
| MHA | "Many heads" | Multi-head attention. |
| Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) | "Shared KV" | Fewer KV heads. |
| KV cache | "Memory" | Cached keys and values. |
| Attention | "Focus" | Weighted average. |

## Further Reading

- [Attention Is All You Need](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1706.03762v7) — again, different URL form.
- [GQA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.13245) — the GQA paper.
